visual.name: bfusionRiskMatrixExtUupm
visual.description: UUPM design-system variant of BFUSION Risk Matrix Extended: Data-Dense Dashboard style, semantic risk-tier palette, Archivo/Space Grotesk typography, WCAG AA. Sandbox build — not for AppSource.

dataRoles.name: impact
dataRoles.description: Impact level — string (e.g. Critical, High) or numeric 1–5

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Risk category for dot colour and radar axes (e.g. Technical, Schedule, Budget)

dataRoles.name: plan
dataRoles.description: Project or plan name shown in tooltip

dataRoles.name: urgency
dataRoles.description: Urgency flag — urgent items render as triangles

dataRoles.name: costImpact
dataRoles.description: Cost impact value shown in tooltip

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

showSmartInsights.description: Render contextual callouts (escalation, concentration, churn) at the bottom of the panel.

showInfoButton.description: Show the (i) information button in the visual header.

infoText.description: Text shown in the info popover.

escalationThreshold.description: Risk score (Impact x Likelihood) at which a risk is treated as critical / escalation-worthy (default 16).

introAnimation.description: Branded splash overlay shown on first render of the visual instance.

enabled.description: Show a branded BFusion splash card on first render. Auto-dismisses after the configured duration.

duration.description: Duration the splash card stays fully visible before fading out (300–3000 ms; default 1200).

title.description: Headline on the splash card. Defaults to the visual's header title or 'BFUSION Risk Matrix'.

staggerReveal.description: Fade in matrix cells and risk dots in a choreographed order after the splash dismisses.
